start: A member who has logged this routine before, mid-workout with 4 exercises of working sets ticked

user_sees: Screen titled 'Workout complete', subtitle 'Saved to your history.'
A grey placeholder while it loads, then the big card 'Kg lifted' with today's total, e.g. '1,925 kg'
must_not: A spinner that never ends
The workout missing from History afterwards

user_sees: '+45 kg more than previous' in green when today beat last time, or 'Same as previous', or 'Lighter than previous. Every workout counts.'
'Previous: 1,880 kg in Push 1 on 15 Oct'
must_not: Warm-up sets counted in today's kg
A red or scolding line for a lighter day
A comparison with a different routine when this routine has a last time

user_sees: '<workout name> done'
One line like '52 min · 18 sets · 1,925 kg lifted · 2 lifts up'
'That's about a grand piano.' only when the total is near a real weight
must_not: A made-up comparison ('a grizzly bear' for 600 kg)
The duration counting paused time

user_sees: The per-exercise summary with new records on the lifts that beat a best
Done returns to the Workout tab
must_not: The summary shown twice
Back reopening the finished workout as still running

start: A member who finishes a workout of only push-ups and pull-ups (no weight)

user_sees: Big card labelled 'Reps done' with e.g. '120 reps'
Compared only with a previous no-weight workout
must_not: '0 kg lifted' on the card
A no-weight workout compared with a weighted one

user_sees: The phone's share sheet with the workout written out as text
must_not: The share sheet opening twice on a fast double tap

start: A member whose workout saved but whose summary cannot be read (a read error)

user_sees: 'Summary unavailable'
'Your workout was saved — we just couldn't load its summary.'
Button 'Done'
must_not: A blank screen or a crash
The workout lost from History

user_sees: The Workout tab
must_not: The workout still shown as in progress

start: A member who finishes a much shorter workout than last time (2 sets in 4 minutes after a full workout)

user_sees: Big card with today's total and 'A shorter workout than the previous one. Every workout counts.'
No 'Previous:' line
must_not: 'Lighter than previous' against a full workout
A sleep or protein tip that reads as blame

start: A brand-new member with no routines who finishes their first workout

user_sees: 'Your first workout' under '<name> done'
Big card with today's total and 'Your number to beat next time.'
must_not: First-workout lifts all shown as new records
A 'Previous:' line with nothing to compare

steps.action: See the card offering to save the workout as a routine and tap its button
user_sees: The card goes and a line says the routine was saved
must_not: Two routines made by a double tap
The offer shown again after it was saved

user_sees: 'Your 10th workout'
must_not: A demo workout counted in the number
The same number shown on two workouts

start: A member signed in to a gym, on the Workout complete screen

user_sees: A picture with the workout name, totals and '+45 kg more than previous' only when today beat last time
The phone's share sheet; the member chooses who gets it
must_not: The picture sent anywhere without the member choosing
Body weight or phone number on the picture

user_sees: Nothing on screen changes
must_not: The workout copied to a MettleUp account when the member never signed in
